title: Bonemealable Spore Blossom
description: Adding the ability to bonemeal plants that are not farmable or bonemealable like Spore Blossom. ✅ Java REALM Compatible
body:
This datapack added a functionality to be able to bonemealed plants that are not farmable like spore blossom.

✅ Java REALM Compatible

### Usage:
- Right click the spore blossom with bone meal.
- **Note:** **Dispensers** can **NOT** use this function only **Players** can.
    - _Im still looking for ways for dispenser to be able to interact the with the spore blossom and other future supported blocks_

![bonemealable spore blossom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f960e36f74044ff365e3c678b5f71a9cc8ae75e.gif)


###  Currently Supported blocks:
- Spore Bloosom
- _MORE in a future updates._

For Suggestion and bug reports you can message me on my discord: yukira2018
